seo.title: About Us | Hotel Zagi in Oroslavje since 1986
seo.description: Hotel Zagi is a family-run three-star hotel in Oroslavje, among the quiet hills of Zagorje 30 km from Zagreb. Hospitality and home cooking since 1986.

hero.title: Hotel Zagi – Zagorje hospitality since 1986
hero.lead: Breathe, taste and touch Croatian Zagorje – and it will touch your heart.

image.alt: View from the hotel balcony over Oroslavje and the Zagorje hills

intro.heading: Among the gentle hills of Zagorje
paragraphs: Hotel Zagi stands in Oroslavje, a quiet town with a long history, just some 30 km – or 30 minutes by car – from Zagreb. Its facilities meet high standards of hospitality.

A few minutes from the main motorway to the coast, it is also ideal for a short break on your journey. From chance visitors to travellers passing through, from family outings to important business meetings – Zagi is a place people love to come back to.

image.alt: Hotel Zagi façade with its sign, entrance and car park

sections.heading: Everything for a comfortable stay
paragraphs: The hotel has 60 modern rooms (150 beds). Rooms have a direct-dial telephone, satellite and LCD TV, a desk with an internet connection, a bathroom with shower, a hairdryer and toiletries. All are equipped with a “Smart room” system and smoke detectors.
Guests can also enjoy the à la carte restaurant, the new wellness centre, a multipurpose hall for up to 60 people, a smaller room for 30 and free parking for cars and coaches.

image.alt: Double room with bathrobes laid out on the bed

sections.heading: Homemade, honest and from the heart
paragraphs: We host celebrations, weddings, christenings, business get-togethers and all kinds of events. We are proud of our rich choice of local and international specialities, fine drinks and wine from our own OPG Čmarec winery.
Our friendly, professional staff are the reason guests from near and far, companies, associations and sports clubs keep coming back all year round.

sections.heading: Zagorje on our doorstep
paragraphs: Croatian Zagorje is famous for its castles, rolling hills, wineries and thermal spas. Hotel Zagi is a contract partner for active holidays and a bike-friendly hotel – a perfect base for day trips.
